title: Block Elements
text:
The `HtmlElement` enum MUST represent all block-level content structures from HTML input. **Required block element variants:** | Variant | Fields | Purpose | |---------|--------|---------| | `Heading` | `level: u8`, `fragments`, `attrs`, `anchor: Option` | h1-h6 headings with optional anchor ID | | `Paragraph` | `fragments`, `attrs` | Text paragraphs | | `CodeBlock` | `code`, `highlighted`, `language`, `attrs`, `filename`, `highlight_lines` | Fenced code with optional highlighting | | `BulletList` | `items: Vec`, `attrs` | Unordered list (recursive items) | | `NumberedList` | `items: Vec`, `attrs`, `start: u32` | Ordered list with optional start number | | `TaskList` | `items: Vec`, `attrs` | Checkbox list | | `DefinitionList` | `items: Vec`, `attrs` | Definition list (dl/dt/dd) | | `Table` | `headers: Vec`, `rows: Vec>`, `attrs` | Tables with enhanced cells | | `Divider` | `attrs` | Horizontal rule | | `Quote` | `fragments`, `attrs`, `cite` | Blockquote with optional citation | | `RawHtml` | `String` | Pass-through HTML | | `Admonition` | `kind`, `title`, `children: Vec`, `attrs` | Callout blocks (note, warning, tip) with block-level content | | `Details` | `summary: Option>`, `children: Vec`, `attrs`, `open: bool` | Disclosure widget with optional summary and block-level content | | `Footnote` | `id`, `fragments` | Footnote definition | **Auxiliary types:** ```rust pub struct ListItem { pub fragments: Vec, pub children: Vec, pub list_type: Option, // hint for nested different-typed lists } pub struct TaskItem { pub fragments: Vec, pub children: Vec, pub checked: bool, } pub struct DefinitionItem { pub term: Vec, pub definition: Vec, } pub struct TableCell { pub fragments: Vec, pub colspan: u32, pub rowspan: u32, pub align: Option, } pub enum ListType { Bullet, Numbered, Task } pub enum AdmonitionKind { Note, Tip, Warning, Danger, Info, Custom(String) } pub enum TextAlign { Left, Center, Right } ``` **Rationale:** Block-level elements define document structure. The recursive `ListItem` enables arbitrary nesting depth, matching HTML's `
  • ` semantics. `TaskItem` separates checkbox lists for platforms with native support. `TableCell` provides layout control. Preserving HTML attributes enables platform-specific rendering features. **Image representation:** Per [[ADR-0011](../adr/ADR-0011.md)], images are always represented as inline fragments (`InlineFragment::Image` or `InlineFragment::ImageMarker`). A standalone `` element at block level parses as a `Paragraph` containing a single image fragment. This unifies image handling and separates content representation (IR) from presentation concerns (adapters decide block vs inline rendering). **SVG representation:** Per [[ADR-0012](../adr/ADR-0012.md)], SVG elements are always represented as inline fragments (`InlineFragment::Svg`). A block-level SVG wrapper (`div.typst-svg-block`) parses as a `Paragraph` containing a single SVG fragment. This unifies SVG handling with the image pattern and maintains consistency in the IR design. **Admonition content:** The `Admonition` variant uses `children: Vec` instead of `fragments: Vec` to support block-level content inside callouts. This enables callouts to contain paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and even nested callouts. This matches GitHub/GitLab behavior where alerts can contain any markdown block, and Notion callouts can contain any block type. **Details content:** The `Details` variant represents HTML `
    ` disclosure widgets with an optional `` element. The `summary` field contains inline content, while `children` contains block-level content (any `HtmlElement`). The `open` boolean tracks whether the details should be expanded by default. This enables collapsible content sections that can contain complex block-level content including paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and nested details. Adapters map this to platform-specific representations: Notion uses callout blocks with folder icons, Markdown renders as raw HTML (no native Markdown equivalent), and other platforms may use toggle/expand components. *Since: v0.1.0* *Changed: v0.3.0 — Admonition.fragments changed to children: `Vec` for block-level content support* *Changed: v0.4.0 — Added Details variant for HTML disclosure widget support*
